title: Assembly
brief:
Build the stack on the pedestal: **spacer**, then **gear** on top, then the **propeller** on top of that.

- Only the **left arm** reaches the spacer, and only the **right arm** reaches the gear.
- The propeller is too wide for one gripper: grip it with **both** arms (`prop`), then carry it with **Move together**: `prop.lift`, `prop.over`, `prop.set`.

The parts must go on in order, so the arms take turns at the pedestal.
hints: The right arm can pick up the gear while the left arm places the spacer. Wait for each other before it reaches the pedestal.
Close both grippers on the propeller, then Wait for each other, then Move together. Opening one gripper lets the propeller go.
